decisions.subject: Development planning priority
decisions.question: How important is job-game takeover readiness for planning?
decisions.decision: Job-game takeover readiness (MA-DOC-006) is critical to the owner and comes first in development planning; it does not reorder the child-facing defect repairs.
decisions.note: Owner, 2026-09-30: the purpose is to take over development of Mermaid Roshan, and including this in the audit is critical. Recorded the same day in master audit section 13 as 'critical to the owner and comes first in development planning'; that line moved to the baseline history on 2026-10-03 without a register entry, so the roadmap lost it.
